taxonomy: All 150 non-oos labels from the official training split; frozen to taxonomy.json before fitting. No subset selection.
action: Recommend enqueueing in support.<intent>; manual_review goes to support.manual_review. No business transaction is executed.
input: One English single-intent utterance, 1..2000 characters, JSON object with text only. Additional fields (including label/options overrides) are invalid.
fallback: Manual triage operator handles invalid, unknown-feature, ambiguous, predicted-oos, low-margin and unavailable-artifact requests.
split: Official train/val/test. Earlier role owns normalized duplicates; later duplicates removed without score access. Near duplicates are diagnostic only. No author/seed IDs available.
development_weighting: Fix OOS prior at 1000/5500 from the documented full test design; remaining mass equally spread across 150 intents. No observed test outcomes used.
stock: No pretrained encoder. Training-only TF-IDF word(1,2)/char_wb(3,5), max 30000 features each, LinearSVC C=1 random_state=17 max_iter=3000 dual=auto; OOS is a learned reject class.
policy: Route only known non-OOS winner, nonempty features, unique maximum, top margin >= cutoff and winner gap >= cutoff. Scores are uncalibrated SVM margins, not probabilities.
selection: Lowest weighted dev loss among policies with OOS misroute <=0.20; ties: greater gap threshold then greater top threshold then lexical candidate ID. If none improves incumbent, retain incumbent. Fixed three-fit sweep then stop.
confirmation: One frozen finalist, no refit. Official test once, paired against always-review. Require mean cost improvement >=0.03, one-sided Hoeffding upper bound on candidate-minus-incumbent < -0.03 (alpha .05, range 1), OOS misroute <=0.20, each intent correct-route recall >=0.30, replay actions identical and scores within 1e-10. Bounds conditional on independent rows; unknown seed families limit inference.
budget: CPU only, one numerical thread; process RLIMIT_CPU=1200 seconds for all fit/search combined; three fits maximum. No paid calls/rentals. Preparation and frozen confirmation timed separately.
authority: Local proxy acceptance only, no production activation. If any gate fails retain the always-review incumbent. No arbitrary new labels, multilingual or multi-intent-per-utterance guarantee.
